manufacturing.minimumFeatureMeasurement: conservative close/open structuring-element diameter on the sampled field

mesh.domain: annulus from clamped hub radius to free outer rim

qualityPolicy.fingerprint: sha256 over float64 node positions and uint32 triangle indices

scientificScope.claimPolicy: The Mandelbrot iteration defines a finite material field; it does not directly generate sound or guarantee Mandelbrot-shaped sand.
established: finite-resolution Mandelbrot field mapped into thickness
limitations: the finite-strip discretization is semi-analytical rather than a triangle shell mesh
the clamped hub is represented as an annular essential boundary
air loading, nonlinear material response, and grain dynamics are omitted
the independent finite-difference check is a reduced cross-check, not certification
runtime textures are a quantized LOD of float64 solver fields
runtime modal scalars are quantized only at the serialization boundary for cross-implementation identity

solver.containerDigestMeaning: OCI image content digest supplied by the executing container runner; it identifies the image used for this bake.
solver.name: mandelhowl-kirchhoff-love-finite-strip

textures.precisionStatement: The emitted ZLIB-supercompressed R8/RG8 KTX2 arrays match the canonical runtime request and are derived from float64 solver modes. The browser inflates the standard scheme-3 payload before portable upload; no Basis/UASTC block compression is claimed.
